label: TP
reason: User-controlled input from request.getParameter() flows directly to response.getWriter() without HTML encoding. The ternary condition (7*42)-num>200 evaluates to false (294-106=188, which is not >200), causing 'param' to always be assigned to 'bar'. User input reaches the sink (toCharArray() printing to response) without sanitization.

evidence.note: User input retrieved via getParameter() flows through ternary operator to bar variable
